name: Kesh
design_note: Starting unit. Balanced physical attacker. Highest-power charge action in the game. 20-item batch (Group E): a slight Spirit weakness balances the Body strength.

name: Ansa
design_note: First recruit. Party heal plus cleanse. Back row so takes x0.70 physical. 20-item batch (Group E): Dark weakness opposes the Light strength.

name: Dorrek
column31: and the roster's strongest Body affinity. Charge action taunts for 3. 20-item batch (Group E): Air weakness opposes the Earth strength - the lumbering tank caught by quick strikes.

name: Vey
design_note: Fastest unit (SPD 25) and highest crit (0.12). 9-hit charge action rolls crit per hit. 20-item batch (Group E): Earth weakness opposes the Air strength.

name: Mirel
design_note: Highest MAG. AoE charge action with a DoT. Lowest HP. 20-item batch (Group E): Water weakness opposes the Fire strength - a real vulnerability given how fragile Mirel already is.

name: Skarn
design_note: Roster expansion (5->10). Reckless crit-fisher - heavy crit bonus plus partial lifesteal on its charge. Rare: stats and charge action (Bloodfury) both scaled up 25% over the original baseline. 20-item batch (Group E): Water weakness opposes the Fire strength.

name: Sorin
design_note: Roster expansion. Armor-piercing melee charge that also applies Frail - melee delivery, magic payload. Rare: stats and charge action (Spellbrand) both scaled up 25%. 20-item batch (Group E): Fire weakness opposes the Water strength.

name: Nyra
design_note: Roster expansion. AoE charge that Enfeebles every foe - shuts down enemy offense from the back line. Rare: stats and charge action (Warding Curse) both scaled up 25%. 20-item batch (Group E): Light weakness opposes the Dark strength.

name: Brenn
design_note: Roster expansion. Self Blurred plus self-taunt on its charge - the dodge-tank answer to Vow of Stone. Rare: stats and charge action (Aegis Step) both scaled up 25%. 20-item batch (Group E): Spirit weakness opposes the Body strength.

name: Sael
design_note: Roster expansion. Light party heal plus Hasted on its charge - trades raw healing for tempo. Rare: stats and charge action (Quicksilver Blessing) both scaled up 25%. 20-item batch (Group E): Body weakness opposes the Spirit strength - a nimble courier, physically fragile.

name: Tovan
design_note: Elemental batch. Fire bruiser - strong Fire affinity and a hard Water weakness.

name: Ilse
design_note: Elemental batch. Water healer - party heal + Regen. Hard Fire weakness.

name: Garrow
design_note: Elemental batch. Earth tank - AoE Slow + taunt. Hard Air weakness.

name: Wren
design_note: Elemental batch. Fast Air skirmisher - five-hit charge. Hard Earth weakness.

name: Lumen
design_note: Elemental batch. Light caster - AoE Blind. Hard Dark weakness.

name: Vesh
design_note: Elemental batch. Dark assassin - huge crit burst. Hard Light weakness.
